Background industrial Dredge ironwork, restrained. No crab legs in head portrait, no helmet, no gun obscuring face. specialty.name: Dredge Firing Angles
specialty.description: Commanded ranged creatures ignore the native shooting penalty through town walls.
specialty.tooltip:
{Dredge Firing Angles}

Native NO_WALL_PENALTY for shooting creatures only. Removes the shooting wall penalty when it would apply. Does not ignore range penalties, line of sight, adjacent engagement, ammunition or attack costs; grants no damage to walls, catapult shots or automatic executions.
